name: Kashmir Beyond the Postcards
description: Village stays, riverside pauses, and a week with room to wander.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Srinagar
itinerary.description: Meet your arranged transfer and settle into your stay. Keep the day flexible around arrival and rest.

itinerary.title: Into the quieter valley
itinerary.description: Drive via Bandipora towards Gurez if the pass is open and permissions are in place. Pause along the way and settle into a village stay.

itinerary.title: Village paths & river views
itinerary.description: Spend the day around Dawar with time for the river, village lanes, and local conversations. Visits are by consent and the day is kept unhurried.

itinerary.title: A little further into the valley
itinerary.description: Explore the Tulail side by road with short optional walks. Your final route depends on permissions, weather, and the group’s needs.

itinerary.title: Back towards the Sind Valley
itinerary.description: Return over the pass and continue towards a riverside stay in the Sind Valley. This is a travel day; stops depend on road conditions.

itinerary.title: A forest walk, or a slower morning
itinerary.description: Choose a locally guided walk around Naranag, subject to suitability, or an easier alternative. Return to Srinagar for the night.

itinerary.title: Until next time
itinerary.description: Check out and take the arranged transfer for your onward journey. Departure timings and road buffers will be confirmed in your proposal.
